completion_decisions: All five published turbine specifications and power anchors are exact.
Missing power curves use a declared cubic energy-law completion.
Missing axial induction is derived from each published CP anchor.
Missing Jensen expansion uses the lineage-standard k=0.075.
Missing Sha Chau array uses a deterministic figure-informed 36-direction by 27-speed reconstruction.
Missing MPGA settings use the audited T62 lineage and are repeated in source-top declarations and the controlling contract.
